comment: monmove.c m_move() sends every tame monster to dogmove.c dog_move(), including a tame minion that is no longer an Angel. A debug lawful Priestess with her starting little dog (so u.uconduct.pets is nonzero) raises her alignment record above 8 by #wizkill-ing two #wizgenesis imps, level-teleports through the ^V '?' menu to the Astral Plane, where minion.c gain_guardian_angel() makes a tame guardian Angel with no edog, takes the Amulet's wish (a food ration), sets her level to 30 and polymorphs into a green slime. Her touches turn the guardian into a green slime (uhitm.c AD_SLIM newcham(), which no magic resistance stops, unlike a wand of polymorph); she turns back into a slime whenever she reverts. The tame green-slime minion then moves through dog_move()'s null-edog path for twelve more turns. The attack directions were chosen by following the guardian turn by turn; Escape answers each --More-- and each debug-mode Die? prompt.
